notes.title: Price Reveal & More!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I'm happy to announce that Elfie: A Sand Plan will be [b]$6.99[/b]! (USD)[/p][p]There's a lot of thought that went into this decision and I wanted to share some of it with you. So without necessarily going into too much details, here are some of the major factors:[/p][list][*][p][i][b]It's a relatively small game.[/b] (Though the level count is growing everyday at the moment haha!)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]It's important to keep it affordable for everyone![/b] (I'd love to go into more details, so perhaps at some point I'll write more about it in a devlog.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Looking at the price point of similar titles.[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][p]You will be able to find the full list of prices at the end of this post! But I have a few more things I'd like to announce![/p][p][/p][h2]New Steam Artwork![/h2][p]Perhaps you'll have notice that the artwork for the game has changed![/p][p]Indeed! We're happy to have collaborated with a Shiromi, a Japanese artist, game dev and friend of the game! She'll be releasing a [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897480/Tiny_Terrors/"]free Halloween themed game in October[/url], so please go check it out![/p][p][/p][h2]GDoCExpo 2025[/h2][p]I'm happy to announce that Elfie: A Sand Plan will be part of the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gdocexpo2025"]GDoCExpo 2025 Steam Showcase![/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656869/912824082155ec0cafb95199409e25c8ecb19717.jpg"][/img]I'm looking forward to catching some of the talks happening. You can find more info about expo [url="https://www.gamedevsofcolor.org/"]here![/url][/p][p](And if some of the talks, panels or interviews interest you and want to grab a ticket, you can use the promo code [b]gdoc10[/b] for 10% off!)[/p][p][/p][h3]Lastly, no demo updates... [b]yet[/b] 👀[/h3][p]But expect to see a new language added to the demo before Steam Next Fest![/p][p][/p][h3]Full price list[/h3][p]USD -- $6.99[/p][p]GB Pounds -- £5.89 [/p][p]Euros -- €6.89 [/p][p]Russian Rubles -- руб.280 [/p][p]Brazilian Reals -- R$23.50 [/p][p]Japanese Yen -- ¥800 [/p][p]Indonesian Rupiah -- Rp65,000 [/p][p]Malaysian Ringgit -- RM19.50 [/p][p]Philippine Peso -- P239.95 [/p][p]Singapore Dollar -- S$7.50 [/p][p]Thai Baht -- ฿155.00 [/p][p]Vietnamese Dong -- ₫90,000 [/p][p]Korean Won -- ₩7,800 [/p][p]Ukrainian Hryvnia -- ₴163 [/p][p]Mexican Peso -- Mex$88.99 [/p][p]Canadian Dollar -- CDN$8.99 [/p][p]Australian Dollar -- A$10.25 [/p][p]New Zealand Dollar -- NZ$10.49 [/p][p]Norwegian Krone -- kr78.00 [/p][p]Polish zloty -- zł29.99 [/p][p]Swiss Francs -- CHF7.75 [/p][p]Chinese Yuan -- ¥29.00 [/p][p]Indian Rupee -- ₹345 [/p][p]Chilean Peso -- CLP$4,200 [/p][p]Peruvian Sol -- S/.17.00 [/p][p]Colombian Peso -- COL$18,500 [/p][p]South African Rand -- R72.00 [/p][p]Hong Kong Dollar -- HK$46.00 [/p][p]Taiwanese Dollar -- NT$138 [/p][p]Saudi Arabian Riyal -- SR16.50 [/p][p]Emirati Dirham -- AED21.00 [/p][p]Israeli New Shekel -- ₪25.95 [/p][p]Kazakhstani Tenge -- ₸2,100 [/p][p]Kuwaiti Dinar -- KD1.45 [/p][p]Qatari Rial -- QR17.99 [/p][p]Costa Rican Colon -- ₡3,300 [/p][p]Uruguayan Peso -- $U220 [/p][p]CIS -- (USD) $4.69[/p][p]SASIA -- (USD) $3.49[/p][p]LATAM -- (USD) $3.49[/p][p]MENA -- (USD) $3.49[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 and macOS
notes.content:
[h2]There is now a macOS version![/h2][p]Some of few may have noticed that the demo is now available for macOS! I hadn't announced anything yet as I was testing things out and was planning to add a few fixes while at it. [/p][p][b]Though the macOS is available, I haven't had the chance to try to run it on older macOS devices.[/b] If you happen to run into any problems, feel free to let me know!
[/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]macOS: There were issues with the double click as macOS seems to not register double clicks the same way and stopped from continuously double clicking blocks to rotate them easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor UI stuff[/p][list][*][p]Some settings weren't being saved properly.[/p][/*][*][p]The scrolling on menus didn't work properly when using sliders.[/p][/*][*][p]Small graphical stuff. Probably wouldn't have been noticeable. But I noticed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]QOL Changes[/h3][list][*][p]It's now also possible to click Elfie's thought bubble to start the dialogue. \[[i]EDIT: This may have not made it in.[/i]][/p][/*][*][p]Space Bar added to be able to continue Elfie's dialogue. Currently it's not possible to remap it but I'll be working on adding that feature to the General options for release and possibly updating it in the demo too.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]When going to the Credits when pausing the game, the player would stay stuck there and have to force quit the game. That should be fixed now.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Modified the hit boxes for the triangular shapes and the stairs. It should be easier to pickup blocks that are behind them and make selecting the block you want to pickup behind other blocks more accurate.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Language[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some Japanese translations that we're mismatch.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Elfie: A Sand Plan Demo Release Date - August 7th
notes.content:
[h2] And it's part of the Wholesome Games Celebration!! [/h2]

I'm super happy to announce that not only will the demo for Elfie: A Sand Plan be released on August 7th, but also that it will be part of the "New Demos" section of the [b]Wholesome Games Celebration!![/b]

The event starts August 7th and lasts until the 14th!
I'm excited to see all the other lineup of games showcased alongside Elfie. And have fun checking out the event!

[i]"And playing our demo hehe", you hear Elfie whisper in the background.[/i]
